name: handler_tkprogressbar
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported as a Tcl/Tk Progress Bars in the GUI

origin.usage: handler_tkprogressbar(intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.gui", 1), target = "terminal", inputs = list(title = NULL, label = "message"), ...)

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.gui, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".

arguments.name: inputs
arguments.text: Which message updates the title and the label. "message" means both non_sticky_message and sticky_message. The default sets the label from any message and leaves the title alone.
Further named arguments. make_progression_handler arguments stay on the handler. The rest are passed to tkProgressBar.

origin.details: Requires Tcl/Tk. The window is width plus 40 by 80. The title defaults to "R progress bar" and the label to empty. The bar value is 100 times the step's fraction of max. clear TRUE destroys the window. clear FALSE leaves the last title, label, and percent.
origin.example: cat("handler_tkprogressbar matches title, label, percent, and size.\n")

translation.description: Report progress with a tkinter ttk progress bar.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.gui, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".

arguments.name: inputs
arguments.text: Which message updates the title and the label. "message" means both non_sticky_message and sticky_message. The default sets the label from any message and leaves the title alone.

arguments.name: extra
arguments.text: Further named arguments. make_progression_handler arguments stay on the handler. The rest are passed to the Tk window.

translation.details: tkinter is the Python standard library for Tcl/Tk. The hidden root is withdrawn, and the toplevel is width plus 40 by 80. A missing Tcl/Tk raises the same requirement message. clear TRUE destroys the window.
translation.example: print("handler_tkprogressbar matches title, label, percent, and size.")
